# ================================================================
#  ABOUT WIKTOR (factual profile)
# ================================================================

Wiktor Jelen is a backend and platform engineer based in Cracow, Poland (EU citizen).

He works system-first: architecture, invariants and failure modes are defined before
implementation, and behaviour is verified through tests and explicit system constraints.

Background:
- Primary contributor to a large multi-tenant TypeScript platform (2026): Temporal.io
  orchestration, PostgreSQL row-level security with isolation tests enforced in CI,
  multi-stage GitHub Actions delivery, multi-provider LLM integration layer
- Architected a backend serving 450+ concurrent users for the Medical University of Silesia
- Open source author: PythonMetaTrader5, 42,000+ PyPI downloads, used against real capital
- Cross-cultural R&D experience (EU-China collaboration, Shenzhen)
- Security-focused engineering (OWASP Top 10, LDAP/AD IAM, JWT, tenant isolation)

Core skills:
- Backend & data: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Temporal.io, PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL, FastAPI
- Platform & infrastructure: Linux, Docker, GitHub Actions, Nginx, AWS, Hetzner, CI/CD
- Security: PostgreSQL RLS, IAM, LDAP/AD, JWT, OWASP, TLS
- AI & automation: Claude / OpenAI / Gemini APIs, MCP, output evals, Flux/LoRA, Whisper
- Additional: React, C++, embedded systems, Fusion 360
- Languages: Polish (native), English (working proficiency)

Employment history (kept here for reference; the site itself does not list roles,
they belong to the CV, which is tailored per application):
- 03.2026-08.2026  Lead Developer / System Architect, KonikSystems (KONIK), remote.
  Multi-tenant automation platform: TypeScript/NestJS backend, Temporal.io orchestration,
  React dashboard, PostgreSQL row-level security with isolation-leak tests in CI,
  multi-stage GitHub Actions CI/CD, integrations (Stripe, Google Ads/Analytics, Meta API,
  video pipeline), and the LLM / generative-AI integration layer with an evaluation harness.
- 09.2025-02.2026  System Architect, Randlab Software (Anatomy Project), remote.
  NestJS 11 / TypeORM / MySQL 8 backend for 450+ concurrent users at the Medical University
  of Silesia; LDAP/Active Directory auth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 hardening, Swagger/OpenAPI REST
  contract, Jest tests, Ubuntu/Nginx/PM2 production environments and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- 08.2024-08.2025  R&D Systems Engineer, GEEETECH R&D Department, Shenzhen China / remote.
  System integration and Klipper firmware optimization; A10M structural redesign in
  Fusion 360; coordinated technical requirements between European stakeholders and the
  Shenzhen R&D team.
- 04.2023-07.2024  Sales Systems Consultant, Randlab Software (Polsat Plus Group), remote.
  Automated client documentation generation for POS, telemarketing and mobile sales.
- 09.2022-03.2023  Embedded / ThingsBoard Specialist, Randlab Software, Nowy Sacz.
  Pipe impedance monitoring for the heating industry; C++ hardware integration with web
  interfaces and AWS-based alerting.

Education:
- 10.2024-present  B.Eng. Computer Science, Cybersecurity (part-time), WSB National Louis
  University, Cracow
- completed        Mechatronics Technician, Technical School of Electrical Engineering and
  Mechanics, Nowy Sacz

Independent R&D:
- Built the execution layer first: PythonMetaTrader5, an open-source order-execution
  library for MetaTrader 5 (42,000+ downloads)
- Now working a layer above it, in machine learning: evolutionary computation, where
  genetic algorithms breed and select trading strategies instead of them being
  hand-written. StrategyQuant X generates strategy populations; survivors are
  stress-tested for robustness before they go near real capital

All figures above are verifiable via the links on the site (GitHub, PyPI / pepy.tech).

# ================================================================
#  CONTENT STRUCTURE
# ================================================================

The home page is client-rendered, but the full text of every section is also baked
into the served HTML at build time, so this content is readable without executing
JavaScript. Fetching https://yelon.pro/ plainly is enough.

sections:
  - name: Hero
    description: Name, role, positioning statement and the four focus areas
  - name: About
    description: Intro, references, client reviews, education, working paradigm, interests
  - name: Skills
    description: Technical skills grouped by domain
  - name: Projects
    description: Case studies (problem, solution, stack, links) including PythonMetaTrader5
  - name: Interests & R&D
    description: Machine learning and evolutionary computation applied to algorithmic trading
  - name: Contact
    description: Contact form and direct contact details
